summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring—at enterprise scale. You need a full platform when you are building, fine-tuning, or operating custom models with governance, reproducibility, and scaling requirements; if you only need to call a pre-trained model (e.g., via an LLM API), a managed model API is far simpler and cheaper. The landscape is led by the three hyperscaler suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), followed by multi-cloud data/ML platforms (Databricks) and specialized AutoML and MLOps tools.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage usage; priced per instance-hour for training, inference, and notebooks. No upfront commitment.
platforms.best_for: AWS-centric teams building and deploying custom models with deep integration into the AWS ecosystem.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage and node-hours; separate pricing for AutoML, prediction, and generative AI token usage.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting a highly automated, state-of-the-art managed pipeline and strong generative AI / Gemini integration on GCP.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by Azure compute/storage usage; no additional platform surcharge beyond underlying resources.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance, responsible AI, and integration with Azure OpenAI.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using Databricks Units (DBUs) plus underlying cloud compute; pay-as-you-go or committed-use.
platforms.best_for: Unified data engineering and collaborative data science teams working across multiple clouds with lakehouse data.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.cloud: Cloud-agnostic (SaaS or self-hosted on any cloud)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; team and enterprise plans priced per seat/usage; self-hosted enterprise licensing available.
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and reproducibility alongside any training stack.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription/licensing, typically annual contract; custom quoted.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and business analysts wanting automated model building and governance with minimal hand-coding.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; Driverless AI and enterprise platform via commercial subscription/licensing.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting open-source-friendly AutoML and explainability, including regulated industries.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.cloud: Serverless (runs on cloud GPUs, cloud-agnostic from user view)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based, pay-per-second for CPU/GPU compute; free starter credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers who want to run training and inference on serverless GPUs with minimal infrastructure management.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro subscription; usage-based Inference Endpoints and enterprise plans.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source transformers and foundation models needing hub, fine-tuning, and managed inference.

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; cost is underlying Kubernetes/cloud infrastructure plus operational effort.
platforms.best_for: Platform teams wanting a portable, Kubernetes-native MLOps stack without vendor lock-in.
